meaning.tension: integer 0..100; quadratic corner reach cap tension/200 processing pixels and at most quarter each incident segment L-infinity length; zero bypass
meaning.eps: integer 0..100; maximum L-infinity simplification deviation eps/200 processing pixels, rounded down to 2^-20 pixel lattice; monotone finite-chord capsule; zero bypass
meaning.denoise: 0..3 simultaneous 3x3 lower-median opaque-neighbor RGB passes; no alpha occupancy change
meaning.k: Maximum opaque palette colors 2..16; material count can be 0 or 1; transparent is never a material
meaning.minA: Integer processed-pixel area threshold; strict-less-than, one snapshot merge into adjacent region already >= threshold; no transparent targets
meaning.res: Actual longest pixel edge cap, one of 360/520/720/960/1280; no upsampling; ties-even other dimension
meaning.smooth: 0..6 synchronous shared-chain binomial passes; pinned endpoints/viewport/junctions/component anchors; actual maximum displacement bound

geometryScope: Processing pixel footprint is not a source geometry or printer-fit error bound; parent owns shared-ID physical quantization and extrusion

constraints.retry: all geometric strengths attenuated by 2^-n, n=0..12, starting from immutable raw chains; requests retained
constraints.fallback: explicit topology-constrained identity after 13 rejected trials; requires confirmation
constraints.certificate: exact i128 intersections/overlap, pins, cyclic junction order, loop orientation, full disconnected nesting and preserved face incidence
constraints.flattening: 1/1024 processing pixels L-infinity plus <=32 dyadic rounding units; max depth16
constraints.physicalQuantization: parent applies shared global 1nm ties-even once, then revalidates topology
